_meta.source: Static, redacted copies of the signed-in notebook.google.com web app (tools/capture/signed-in/snapshot.js) with every same-origin stylesheet inlined, loaded from file:// in headless Chromium; Google Fonts and gstatic come through a local cache. Nothing was requested from notebook.google.com itself.
_meta.themes: Every copy was taken in dark. Light is the same copy with the body class dark-theme swapped for light-theme, which is what the in-app Light mode does. Dark states have plain names; light states are `light`, `light-<state>`. Every state records `theme` and `snapshot`.

states.hover: real mouse hover (page.mouse.move), 450ms settle; not measured on the 390 copies
states.focus-visible: real keyboard focus (focus, Shift+Tab, Tab) on the element or its first focusable descendant; recorded as skipped where the element cannot take focus
states.pressed: mouse hover, then the button held down for 250ms (:active)
states.other: selected / open / readonly / off / option-highlighted are other elements or copies captured in that state

_meta.tokens: `vars` lists every var(--x) named in the classes of the element and its first descendants (NotebookLM's classes name none, so this is usually empty; the theme variables are read by tools/capture/read-css.mjs).
